description:
The weakest student in the human world... Lee Boram, the absolute powerhouse who has reigned as the strongest in hell... The strange symbiotic relationship between the two begins. For Lee Bo-ram, who is bullied every day, reality is no different from hell. The Demon King Bangkoop, who took refuge by borrowing this body of reward, is a troublemaker who yearns for battle more than anyone else. What changes will occur in Lee Bo-ram's school life, the worst symbiotic relationship that doesn't fit at all? An unpredictable academy action fantasy!
